_comment: Sample Windows enrollment platform restriction — reference for INTBASE - Windows Enrollment - Pilot. Configure in Intune: Devices > Enrollment > Windows > Enrollment device platform restrictions. Field names mirror the Graph deviceEnrollmentPlatformRestrictionConfiguration resource.
description: Corporate-only Windows enrollment for the first-time pilot.

_notes.stance: personalDeviceEnrollmentBlocked=true keeps the pilot to corporate devices; relax later if you want personal (BYOD) Windows enrollment.
_notes.osMinimumVersion: 10.0.17763 = Windows 10 1809, the minimum for modern enrollment. Home edition cannot enroll regardless.
